item.title: Whiskers 0.8.62
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.62

### Dictation Quality

  • Improved local dictation and AI Enhancement so screen context and custom vocabulary help preserve names, code terms, filenames, and specialized wording
  • Improved Bluetooth and AirPods recording so quiet speech, pauses, and device changes are less likely to clip or drop words
  • Improved live cloud dictation so longer sessions finish more reliably instead of getting stuck in processing

    • ### Home & Playback

  • Redesigned transcript history into a clearer day-by-day timeline with smoother row expansion and playback controls
  • Improved transcript audio playback with a clearer waveform playhead and better alignment

    • ### Setup & Settings

  • Refreshed settings, onboarding, and HUD controls with clearer focus, hover, and accessibility states
  • Added live microphone level feedback in Microphone Settings and turned voice activity detection on by default for cleaner recordings
  • Added safer model deletion confirmation and clearer file transcription retry, cancel, and unsupported-file handling

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed file transcription access messaging so free users are guided by the weekly word quota instead of a separate daily file limit
  • Fixed clipboard restore and dictation cancellation edge cases that could leave text insertion or recording state inconsistent
  • Fixed transcript loading failures so Home can show an error with a retry option
